name: Hokubu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Hokubu town emblem in white: a stylised device of two facing lobes, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Hokubu in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 1991-02-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1968.

features.role: Hokubu town emblem — a stylised device of two facing lobes, like a stylised character
